snippet.title: Oil Closed Above $100. Energy Stocks Barely Moved.
snippet.description:
Brent settled at $100.69 after attacks on two Saudi oil tankers raised risk around another Middle East shipping route. The S&P 500 fell as VIX rose, but XLE and Occidental Petroleum surrendered most of their opening gaps.

The Associated Press reported the tanker event, Brent settlement, and closing market context: https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-iran-trump-ai-inflation-45b9165d6c518f5bea668b6ba7a89838

The portfolio test is the producer-equity response. XLE closed at 59.38 after opening at 60.244. A later close above 60.3768 would confirm a higher range; a close below 59.20 would turn weak confirmation into rejection.

Research tooling, not financial advice. No performance is promised or implied.
